text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. It allows machines to recognise faces, read text, and identify objects in pictures. One important task is object detection, where a computer finds and locates things in an image, such as people or vehicles. This technology has many real-world applications. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to detect other cars, pedestrians, and road signs, which helps them drive safely. It is also used in medical imaging, security systems, and shopping apps. As computer vision improves, it will change many parts of our daily lives.
